chapter: Postwar: Chicago, Vinson, Hines and Cootie
title: Joining Earl Hines in Chicago
summary: Back from New York he joined Hines in Chicago, recommended by Scoop Carry and with Budd Johnson in the band.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Playing in Lionel Hampton's big band

blocks.x: Yeah, right. Well, listen, so from St. Louis, what did you do? Go to Chicago?
No, I went back to New York.
Well, then, where did Earl reach you?
Well, he wired you or something?
Yes. I happened to know some of the guys in his band, anyway.
Well, I knew Bud Johnson and I knew the other alto and clarinet player.
Yeah. And Scoop had heard me play and he told him about me.
Well, now, Diz and Charlie weren't with him then.
Oh, no. No. They came afterwards, I think it was. What year was --

Well, I'm just trying to think. Just one second. Worked with Earl Hines and Cootie Williams until joining Basie in late '49. When they were with Earl, the recording ban went into effect and there were no records at the time. Time when Bird and Diz were playing with Earl, that was never on wax.
